records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the second quarter of 2023 totaled $321.7 million, a 14.8% increase as compared to consolidated net sales of $280.2 million in the second quarter of 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: Our operating performance during the second quarter of 2023 has benefited from fewer supply chain disruptions enabling us to obtain key component parts, increase production and reduce backlog.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED JUNE 30, 2023
records.text: Our order backlog was $255.2 million at June 30, 2023 compared to $326.4 million at December 31, 2022.

records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities during the six months ended June 30, 2023 was $70.2 million compared to net cash used by operating activities of $23.6 million during the six months ended June 30, 2022.
